tables.title: Control of the common clock generation
tables.text_helper: Table 279, "Control of the common clock generation", in section 35.4.5 (Clock generator (CKGEN)) on page 1637. Columns: CCKyEN, CCKyDIR, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. The configuration with CCKyEN = 1 and CCKyDIR = 0 must be avoided (no interest).

rows:
The MDF_CCKy pin is in input. An external clock can be connected to the MDF_CCKy pin 
and used by the SITFx in order to decode the serial stream

The MDF_CCKy pin is in output. No clock is generated, thus the MDF_CCKy pin is driven 
low.

The MDF_CCKy pin is in output. A clock is generated on the MDF_CCKy pin. The SITFx 
can use this pin as clock source in order to decode the serial stream
notes: 1. The configuration with CCKyEN = 1 and CCKyDIR = 0 must be avoided (no interest).
